candidates.change_summary: Delete the require statement, removing the overflow check on depositsCount.
Replace depositsCount++ with depositsCount = depositsCount + 2, causing depositsCount to increment by two instead of one.
Replace depositsCount++ with depositsCount--, causing depositsCount to decrement instead of increment.
Insert depositsCount++ before the require statement, causing two increments per call, which changes the final depositsCount.
Replace the require condition with a condition that always reverts, preventing depositsCount from ever being incremented.
Remove the require statement in the modifier, making onlyOwner no-op
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with a call that transfers 0 wei instead of the full balance
Delete the entire body of withdrawAll so it does nothing
Replace transfer with an empty statement so withdraw sends nothing, changing the balance transfer behavior.
Replace msg.sender with address(0) so Ether is transferred to the zero address, making it effectively burned instead of reaching the sender.
Replace payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value) with a call that always reverts, so withdraw always fails.
Change the modifier from onlyOwner to empty so anyone can call withdraw instead of only the owner.
Replace msg.sender == owner with true so the onlyOwner modifier always passes, letting anyone call protected functions.
